excerpt.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
excerpt.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

scope.zh: 已对照游戏文件核对入口与触发、条件、选项与结果、分类，并撰写双语导读。
scope.en: Root and trigger, conditions, options and outcomes, and category checked against the game files; bilingual guide written.

uncertain: New Bratulla is spawned at the end of the Chronicles of Dendrus site story (site-site-chronicles-of-dendrus, c2-precursors).

texts.zh: 我们确认了《邓德里历代志》中所记载的那颗行星——新布拉图雅的存在。它拥有独特而丰富多样的植物生态系统，初步调查发现了数百万不同的本地物种。
texts.en: We have confirmed the existence of New Bratulla, the planet described in the Dendritian Chronicles. It possesses a uniquely rich and diverse botanic ecosystem, with initial surveys detecting millions of different native species.

texts.zh:
这颗精美绝伦的行星特别适合支持我们这样的植物生命形态。这里的土壤生活着万亿可以滋养、保护和修复有机根组织的各种细菌。

植物的营养似乎是按需分配的，那些暂享丰盛的植物通过相互联系的根系分享多余营养。
texts.en:
This fascinating world is particularly suited to supporting plant-based lifeforms with genetics like ours. Its soils are home to billions of different bacteria which nourish, protect, and repair organic root structures.

Plants seem to share nutrients according to greatest need, with those enjoying a temporary abundance sharing their surplus via an interconnected root system.

texts.zh:
这颗精美绝伦的行星特别适合支持类似邓德里人那样的植物生命形态。这里的土壤生活着万亿可以滋养、保护和修复有机根组织的各种细菌。

植物的营养似乎是按需分配的，那些暂享丰盛的植物通过相互联系的根系分享多余营养。
texts.en:
This fascinating world is particularly suited to supporting plant-based lifeforms with genetics like that of the Dendritians. Its soils are home to billions of different bacteria which nourish, protect, and repair organic root structures.

Plants seem to share nutrients according to greatest need, with those enjoying a temporary abundance sharing their surplus via an interconnected root system.

texts.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信，将方舟里发现的邓德里人基因样本移植到这颗行星不同寻常的土壤中就可以重建他们的物种。
texts.en: Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it may be possible to re-establish the Dendritian species here by transplanting genetic samples recovered from their arkship to this planet's unusual soils.

label.en: This world is perfect for us.
This world is perfect for us.

label.zh: 这颗崭新的星球将由我们来利用。
label.en: This untapped world is ours to exploit.

texts.zh:
几百年了……《邓德里历代志》中的预言的已经实现了。我们终于在新布拉图雅生根发芽。

我们能到达这里，必须感谢[Root.GetName]。我们永远不会忘记的。

我们的感激之情无以言表，只有行动可以说明。我们谦卑地向您宣誓效忠。
texts.en:
It took centuries... but that which the Dendritian Chronicles foretold has come to pass. Finally, on New Bratulla, we lay root and prosper.

That we exist here is thanks to the [Root.GetName]. We shall not forget this.

Our gratitude will be expressed not only in word, but in deed. We humbly offer you our vassalage.

label.zh: 我们要见证你们的命运。
label.en: We must see your destiny unfold.

tooltips.zh: 作为邓德鲁斯之苞进行游戏。
tooltips.en: Play as the Buds of Dendrus.

label.zh: 只要你们的知识就足够了。

# 新布拉图雅 / New Bratulla

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Extreme Frontiers · 来源 Sources：`events/extreme_frontiers_events.txt:4262-4520`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1175`、`common/scripted_effects/extreme_frontiers_scripted_effects.txt:237-265` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

这是“德纳斯编年史”遗址线（site-site-chronicles-of-dendrus，c2-precursors 负责）之后的一幕：编年史项目完成后，退化的超空间航道被修复，spawn_new_bratulla_system（extreme_frontiers_scripted_effects.txt:237）生成新布拉图雅星系并给行星设置 new_bratulla 旗标。勘测该行星时（on_survey_planet，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1175）触发 extreme_frontiers.1430。

This is the scene after the Chronicles of Dendrus site story (site-site-chronicles-of-dendrus, owned by c2-precursors): once the chronicles project is done and the degraded hyperlane restored, spawn_new_bratulla_system (extreme_frontiers_scripted_effects.txt:237) creates the New Bratulla system and flags the planet new_bratulla. Surveying it (on_survey_planet, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1175) fires extreme_frontiers.1430.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1430“新布拉图雅”（4262-4380）：发现编年史中记载的植物世界；选项a（非杀戮型、已有基因调整/表观遗传触发科技、食物≥500）：花费500食物，获得社会科研月度加成，1天后发出 1435“附庸提议”复活德纳斯人；选项b（“这个世界很适合我们”，4343-4380）只给社会科研月度加成并结束事件链，不复活德纳斯人。1435 创建德纳斯人国家，有三个选项：接受其成为附庸（影响力月度加成）、直接接管（把该国家交给玩家）、仅取其知识（按已赠予的生物科技数给科研加成并赠送科技），都结束“德纳斯编年史”事件链。

1430 "New Bratulla" (4262-4380): the botanical world described in the chronicles is found. Option a (non-homicidal, Gene Tailoring or Epigenetic Triggers, 500 food) spends 500 food, gives a monthly society-research bonus and 1 day later sends 1435 "Vassalage Offer" which revives the Dendritians. Option b ("This world is perfect for us", 4343-4380) only gives the society-research bonus and ends the event chain without reviving them. 1435 creates the Dendritian country and offers three options: accept them as vassals (monthly influence bonus), take them over directly (the country is handed to the player) or take only their knowledge (research bonus scaled by the biotechs already given, plus technologies); all end the "Chronicles of Dendrus" chain.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

1430 的选项a与b互斥；只有选项a通向 1435；1435 的三个选项互斥。

Options a and b of 1430 are exclusive; only a leads to 1435; the three options of 1435 are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

正文依是否光合物种、是否杀戮型、是否有基因科技而变；1435 会按已存在的星球肖像选择 pla11 / pla15 / pla9。

1430 text varies by phototrophic species, homicidal status and gene tech; 1435 picks portrait pla11 / pla15 / pla9 depending on which already exist.
